name: Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Co., Ltd.
summary: Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. is a Beijing-based miner founded in 1998 that explores, mines, processes and sells gold in China, Southeast Asia and West Africa, and also searches for zinc, lead, copper, molybdenum and silver. Side activities include copper smelting, disposal of hazardous industrial waste, dismantling of discarded electronics and recycling of power batteries. Until 2012 it was called Guangdong Oriental Brothers Investment.
